title: Right ordinary evaluation comparison
statement: Fix the triple product diagram, fixed-scalar ordinary derived pullbacks, tensor comparisons and explicit evaluation composites $\rho,\rho_3$ of [def-pur-ordinary-product-transpose-data]. For arbitrary unbounded $M_i\in D_{X_i}$, $F_i\in D_B$, and arbitrary maps $x_i:L_{f_i}F_i\to M_i$, the composite that transports $L_v$ to $L_{b(q_2f_2)}$, applies the pullback of the source associator, applies $\rho$ for the outer right square with maps $x_1$ and the transport of $\rho_{23}(F_2,F_3;x_2,x_3)$ from $L_{q_3f_3}$ to $L_{q_2f_2}$, then the specified right external-tensor identification, equals $\rho_3(F_1,F_2,F_3;x_1,x_2,x_3)$. This is an equation only of pullback/tensor comparisons and arbitrary maps; no direct-image product or adjunction appears.

proof.text: The three-map pullback cocycle identifies the factorization through the double product with that through the individual projection; use the published fixed-scalar leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc_app. Equality transport uses the square equations. Tensor bifunctoriality combines the three arbitrary maps. Associativity of the pullback tensor comparison carries the source associator to the target; it cancels the inverse associator in the right tensor identification. Use b q2 = a p2 and b q3 = c to identify the last two projections, leaving the specified ordered triple evaluation.

theorem ordinaryTripleRightComparison :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (d.squareR.w.symm.trans ((Category.assoc d.a d.p₁ f₁).trans
        (congrArg (fun z ↦ d.a ≫ z) d.square₁₂.w))).symm).hom.app ((F₁ ⊗ F₂) ⊗ F₃) ≫
      (P.ordinaryPull (d.b ≫ (d.q₂ ≫ f₂))).map (α_ F₁ F₂ F₃).hom ≫
      P.ordinaryBinaryEvaluation d.squareR F₁ (F₂ ⊗ F₃) K
        (P.ordinaryExternal d.q₂ d.q₃ L M) x
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
          d.square₂₃.w).hom.app (F₂ ⊗ F₃) ≫
          P.ordinaryBinaryEvaluation d.square₂₃ F₂ F₃ L M y z) ≫
      (P.ordinaryTripleRightIdentification d K L M).hom =
    P.ordinaryTripleEvaluation d K L M F₁ F₂ F₃ x y z
